Class NodeUtils

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.utils.NodeUtils
public final class NodeUtils extends Object
Shared node presentation helpers: lookup, avatar styling, and the node details table used by the main node list and chat-related views.

  • Method Details

    • resolveNode

      public static NodeData resolveNode(DeviceState state, int nodeNum)
      Resolves a node by numeric id, preferring the current DeviceState and enriching sparse entries from the persistent cache.
      Parameters:
      state - current device state, or null
      nodeNum - numeric node id
      Returns:
      the richest available NodeData, or null when no source has it

    • resolveNode

      public static NodeData resolveNode(DeviceState state, String nodeId)
      Resolves a node by Meshtastic node id, preferring the current DeviceState and falling back to the cache.
      Parameters:
      state - current device state, or null
      nodeId - node id, for example "!9e755af0"
      Returns:
      the richest available NodeData, or null when no source has it

    • chatAvatarFontSize

      public static double chatAvatarFontSize(int charCount, int circleSize)
      Returns a stable avatar font size for chat lists and chat headers. It is slightly larger than the general rule and avoids layout-bound measurement so selection and focus changes do not make the text jump.

    • fillDetailRows

      public static void fillDetailRows(javafx.collections.ObservableList<String[]> rows, NodeData node)
      Populates the node details table rows. Each row is String[]{emoji, label, value}; the emoji is rendered as a PNG image.

    • createDetailTable

      public static javafx.scene.control.TableView<String[]> createDetailTable(javafx.collections.ObservableList<String[]> rows)
      Creates the two-column, headerless node details table. Rows follow the String[]{emoji, label, value} shape.
